item.title: Build 696
item.description: • Glass, if you want it. Settings, General, Surfaces: Solid (as before) or Glass. With Glass on, what is behind the window shows through blurred, in the toolbar, the gaps and faintly through the panes. The glass is set so text keeps the contrast it has on Solid even with a white window behind Mayfly, and the boxes you type into stay solid. It switches back to Solid whenever Reduce transparency is on in System Settings.
